scope: Offline intervention evidence routes between two separately learned numerical-feature outcome models after an action-consequence rule reversal; not general online causal discovery.
previous_source: collect/train/0..79 via frozen original benchmark with public sensor outcomes
second_model: route-reversed/train/300..379, 80 random exploration episodes with public sensor outcomes only
calibration: train/900..911, twelve disposable episodes per seed per world, one selected public action/event per episode, chosen by model disagreement, with harm counted and without private rule information sent to the selector.
evaluation: test/14000..14059, 60 target episodes per seed/world, models immutable during test
limitations: Both rules and numeric feature->effect relation are engineered; no natural perception
The changed rule is explicitly given as a training family to the offline harness, not discovered by a live agent
Calibration probes occur in disposable simulator episodes, may be harmful, and would not be safe in real world
Six source seeds have already been inspected; not blind generalization
Selection between only two predefined models, cannot recognize a third unseen rule
Original outcome learner, benchmark, protocol, default and main remain untouched
No unauthenticated auto-promotion or OS/network interaction
preserve: original frozen numeric outcome-transfer benchmark including harmful reversed outcomes
